i.norm:
Verifies how {@link Entities#escape(String, OutputSettings)} handles a supplementary (astral-plane) character whose code point sits above the Basic Multilingual Plane.

The input is U+1D559 (MATHEMATICAL DOUBLE-STRUCK SMALL H), represented in Java as the surrogate pair {@code 𝕙}. Each scenario below changes the output charset and escape mode to confirm the character is escaped (or left intact) as expected.
U+1D559 (MATHEMATICAL DOUBLE-STRUCK SMALL H), encoded as a UTF-16 surrogate pair.
ASCII cannot represent the character, and base mode has no named entity for it, so it falls back to a numeric character reference.
ASCII still cannot represent the character, but extended mode knows a named entity (𝕙) for this code point, so it is preferred over the numeric form.
UTF-8 can encode the character directly, so no escaping is needed.
